packageRules.description: tests.yaml's python-version is the image's python3 (ubuntu:26.04 ships 3.14), so the tests prove the interpreter that ships. It moves only with the Dockerfile's base image, in the same PR. A lone bump is a 'minor' the fleet auto-merge gate would land (homelab#1935).
A new Ubuntu base changes python3, the GL libs and the Blender runtime. Never auto-merge it: bump tests.yaml's python-version in the same PR and re-run the node-03 render diff (homelab#1935 AC1).
